item.description: "Reaching for more" is the theme of the documentary movie, Queen of Versailles, currently playing at the Nick. It's the story of a billionaire and his wife who are building the largest house in the country, modeled after the palace at Versailles, complete with golden throne. By the end of the movie, the economy has crashed and they've gone from riches to rags (well, not exactly, but construction has stopped and the megamegamegamansion (which was to include a bowling alley, 23 bathrooms, and full-size basketball court) is in foreclosure. It's really about all of us, and it helps to think of myself as the Queen of Versailles when my wants get in the way of my serenity.
